claims.text: The resort is set on the cliff tops above the Pacific Ocean in Acapulco's Diamond Zone.

findings.quote: Set on the cliff tops above the glistening Pacific Ocean, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués is a hidden gem in Acapulco’s Diamond Zone
findings.note: Cliff-top location above the Pacific in the Diamond Zone is stated.

claims.text: Located in Punta Diamante, the resort is set within a gated cliffside enclave.

findings.quote: Located in Punta Diamante, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués is set within a gated cliffside enclave

claims.text: The villas blend Thai-inspired design with Mexican craftsmanship.

findings.quote: Step inside to discover a singular blend of Thai-inspired design and Mexican craftsmanship, each detail thoughtfully curated.

claims.text: All villas include a private pool, with heating available upon request.

findings.quote: Yes, all our villas include a private pool, maintained at a comfortable temperature, with heating available upon request.

claims.text: Guests can choose from villa locations and views including Hillside, Bay View, Ocean View and Oceanfront, subject to availability.

findings.quote: Yes, guests can choose from various room locations and views, including Hillside, Bay View, Ocean View, and Oceanfront, subject to availability.

claims.text: The Ocean View Two-Bedroom Family Pool Villa has two separate pavilions, one with a king-size bed and one with twin beds, a shared sundeck and a heated private pool overlooking the Pacific.

findings.quote: featuring two separate pavilions with a king-size bed in one bedroom and twin beds in the other, a shared sundeck, and a heated private pool overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
findings.note: Describes the Ocean View Two-Bedroom Family Pool Villa – King + Twin.

claims.text: Spa guests are led to a private therapy pavilion, where they sip herbal tea during a foot bath.

findings.quote: A dedicated Spa Concierge leads you to a tranquil private therapy pavilion where you can sip herbal tea while being treated to a soothing foot bath.

claims.text: Besides the private villa pools, the resort has the Reflections Infinity Pool near Cello restaurant.

findings.quote: In addition to a private pool in every villa, the Reflections Infinity Pool, located near Cello restaurant, provides a serene atmosphere and spectacular views.

claims.text: The Las Rocas Infinity Pool sits in an intimate corner of the resort along the coastline.

findings.quote: Take a dip in our infinity pool, set in an intimate corner of Cabo Marqués along the coastline
findings.note: Stated under the Las Rocas Infinity Pool heading.

claims.text: Saffron is the resort's Thai restaurant.

findings.quote: At the heart of our culinary offering is Saffron, our acclaimed Thai restaurant

claims.text: Cello serves Northern Italian cuisine.

findings.quote: Cello presents the essence of Northern Italian cuisine

claims.text: Resort activities include tequila and mezcal tastings and cooking classes.

findings.quote: Try Mexico’s finest tequila and mezcal as you learn about its history, or discover your culinary talents in our cooking classes.
findings.note: Both activities are listed on the resort activities page.

claims.text: The Oceanfront Pool Villa has a king-size bed oriented toward the horizon, expansive verandas and a private heated infinity pool that seems suspended above the water.

findings.quote: it features a king-size bed oriented toward the horizon, expansive verandas, and a private heated infinity pool seemingly suspended above the water.

claims.text: The spa combines Asian healing traditions with Mexico's apapacho.

findings.quote: Discover our spa, where Asian healing traditions meet the warmth of Mexico’s apapacho, an embrace for body and soul.

claims.text: Signature spa treatments are Thai and Balinese massages enhanced with Mexican ingredients like honey, cacao and lavender.

findings.quote: Experience Thai and Balinese massages enhanced with Mexican ingredients like honey, cacao, and lavender.
findings.note: Stated under the Banyan Signatures heading.

claims.text: The Wellbeing Sanctuary Pool Villa has spaces for yoga, meditation and private practice, with wellbeing equipment such as yoga mats.

findings.quote: this peaceful sanctuary features multifunctional spaces for yoga, meditation, and private practice, complete with curated wellbeing equipment such as yoga mats and fitness essentials.

claims.text: An in-villa barbecue service turns the villa's timber terrace into a private open-air restaurant with a personal chef.

findings.quote: our bespoke Acapulco in-villa barbecue service transforms your personal timber terrace into an exclusive, open-air restaurant
findings.note: Covers the timber terrace and the open-air restaurant.

findings.quote: with a personal chef who carefully prepares premium cuts of meat and fresh catches of the day

claims.text: Because of its clifftop location, the resort has no on-site beach; beach clubs are about 20 minutes away.

findings.quote: No, due to our clifftop location, the resort does not have an on-site beach. However, we can recommend beach clubs located about 20 minutes away

claims.text: The resort is about 15 km, roughly a 25-minute drive, from Acapulco city centre.

findings.quote: We are conveniently located 15 km (approx. 25-minute drive) away from Acapulco city centre.

claims.text: The resort is primarily designed for couples and does not offer dedicated children's facilities, though families are welcome.

findings.quote: while Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués is primarily designed for couples and tranquil getaways, we also welcome families.
findings.note: Covers the primary design for couples and that families are welcome.

findings.quote: Please note that the resort does not offer dedicated children’s facilities.
findings.note: Covers the absence of dedicated children's facilities.
